# Pointagram

Pointagram is a gamification tool that increases motivation and team achievements. Keep your team goal-oriented and celebrate great performance together.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/pointagram/.

## Actions

- **Add Score**: Add points to Pointagram players in a score series.
- **List Competition Players** (read-only): Fetch competition players and standings in Pointagram.
- **List Competitions** (read-only): Fetch competitions in Pointagram with optional filtering.
- **List Players** (read-only): Fetch and list players in Pointagram with optional filtering.
- **List Score Series** (read-only): List all score series in Pointagram.
- **List Teams** (read-only): Fetch and list all teams in Pointagram.
- **List Score Series History** (read-only): Fetch historical point data for a score series.
- **List Score Series Point Types** (read-only): Fetch point types for a specific score series in Pointagram.
